Name: Arcane Table Mod
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Current version: [/b]1.1.1[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Fix animation to work with new version of JA.[/size]

[/list]
[b][size=3]Objective: [/size][/b]
To provide the player a reliable way to get monster loot on a regular basis.

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8178/]Unzip the Arcane Table Mod[/url]﻿﻿ into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536/]Unzip the Mail Framework Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970/]Unzip the Producer Framework Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2516/]Unzip the Custom Crystalarium Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720/]Unzip the Json Assets Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]How does it work[/b]:[/size]
[list]
[*]The Wizard will send you a letter teaching you the recipe once you have slain enough monster and have a good relationship with him. [spoiler]500 monsters and 6 heart friendship[/spoiler]
[*]Once you have a arcane table, you can place monster loot on it to reproduce it.
[*]The monster loot you placed should be taken back immediately for the table to start working.
[*]While working the table will be a light source.
[*]Once an produced monster loot is taken, the table will immediately start to produce a new one.
[*]You can place a different monster loot on a working table and it will change to produce that new loot instead.
[*]To stop the table you will need to remove it from the floor.
[*]Time it take to reproduce the loots:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Slime: 2 hours
[*]Bat Wing: 6 hours
[*]Bug Meat: 10 hours
[*]Solar Essence: 16 hours
[*]Void Essence: 20 hours
[*]Bone Fragment: 5 hours
[*]Squid Ink: 1 Day 13 Hours 20 Minutes
[*]Dragon Tooth: 3 Days 11 Hours 40 Minutes
[/list][/spoiler][*]You can automate the arcane table using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8193]CCRMAutomate [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=3][b]
Internationalization:[/b][/size]
[size=2]It has an official translation for pt-BR.[/size][size=2]
Feel free to send me a translation to your language and I might add it on future versions.

[size=3][b]Uninstall:[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=2]Delete the mod from the installation folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Special Thanks:[/b][/size][list]

[/list]
